slots.notes: Fullscreen looping, muted, autoplaying hero background video covering the entire viewport via object-cover; all content layers above it at z-10.
Five overlapping circular avatar portraits (w-8 h-8 rounded-full, -space-x-2.5) inside the social-proof badge; professional headshots, cropped to circle.
Small circular brand logo mark in the nav (h-10 w-10) — native is a circular orange-red disc with a white stylized letter; tints to the brand accent color.

mechanic: Fullscreen object-cover looping video background with a z-10 centered content stack, revealed by three staggered fade-rise keyframes (24px translate-up + opacity, 0.8s ease-out, delays 0/0.2/0.4s) and a glassmorphic backdrop-blur stats bar pinned at the bottom.
techDelivery: single-file CDN Tailwind utility classes with hand-authored @keyframes in a <style> block; HSL CSS custom property for the background fallback.
reskinNotes: Colors are expressed as Tailwind utility classes (gray-900/800/600, white/10, white/20, gray-900/10) hardcoded in markup rather than CSS variables, so reskinning means find-replacing class names, not editing tokens; only the dark-blue --background fallback is a real variable. All copy (headline, subtext, nav labels, the four stat value/label pairs, social-proof line) is hardcoded inline. The logo is generated as a raster/SVG mark with the orange-red fill baked in, so accent retint requires regenerating the asset. Instrument Serif is imported but not bound to any declared element (latent accent font).
